fato_historico: 1857: The Mountain Meadows massacre: Mormon settlers and Paiutes massacre 120 pioneers at Mountain Meadows, Utah.
energia_do_dia: Today, your Leo spirit may feel the weight of history's echoes, perhaps reminding us all that even in the deepest valleys, compassion remains our true path. It is a good time to consider how your warmth can mend past divides. Let your heart shine as a beacon of unity, turning every challenge into a golden opportunity for collective growth.
frase_do_dia: Let your inner light illuminate the path to understanding and gentle peace today.
significado_numero: A powerful gateway for spiritual awakening and personal intuition.
conselho: Practice radical kindness and listen more than you speak to others today.
